protocol.validation: group K-fold by InChIKey: a fresh permutation of the sorted compound keys per repeat, dealt round-robin, whole compounds held out
protocol.leak_reference: row-level random_row, reported once to size the leak it creates
protocol.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters
protocol.physical_block: frozen xTB vector with T_K replaced by the observation's T_K
protocol.paired_rule: folds are dealt over the compounds of the scored mask only, so protocols that score the same rows share one fold assignment even when their training pools differ

paired_base.description: train and score on the frozen v11 room-temperature rows, grouped 10x5

paired_plus_coverage.description: train on the v11 room rows plus the room rows of every new compound the frequency gate admitted; score the same frozen v11 room rows on the same folds

paired_plus_new_xtb.description: same scored rows and folds as paired_base, training widened only by the new compounds whose xTB features were computed in this round

paired_plus_v03_block.description: same scored rows and folds as paired_base, training widened only by the new compounds whose features already sat in the frozen v03 block

fixed_pool_family.shared_fold_basis: the scored room-band rows of every fold, repeat by repeat
fixed_pool_family.comparability: the scored rows, the folds and the denominator are identical across every protocol here, so each delta has exactly one cause

extended_pool_room.description: train and score on every room-temperature row of the merged table, grouped over every compound that has features

extended_pool_room_random_row.description: LEAK REFERENCE ONLY: same rows as extended_pool_room but split by row, so one compound reaches both sides of a fold. Never a conclusion number.

leak_reference.note: reported to size the leak only; never a conclusion number

extended_pool_family.comparability: a different scored pool from the fixed-pool family, so its R2 is NOT comparable to the 0.4091 of band_room_only; the pool variance is reported for that reason

verdict.statement: 50 compounds added to the training material move grouped Morgan+Physical R2 by +0.1241 (helps)
